steps.text: 1. The Admin opens the "Accounts" page, searches by email or name, filters by role and status.
2. The system returns the account list (20 items per page). E2.

exceptions.text: E2. No valid token → 401; not an Admin → 403; invalid parameters → 400.

steps.text: 4. The system shows the account information and the number of signed-in sessions (Auth) with the violation history (Tour): tour count by status, hidden / rejected tours with reasons, reports received, the 20 latest actions. E1.

exceptions.text: E1. The account does not exist → 404 "Account not found".

steps.text: 5. The Admin chooses "Warn", "Suspend" (1 / 7 / 30 days or an end date, up to 365 days) or "Ban", enters a reason (1–1000 characters) and confirms. A1, A2, E6.

exceptions.text: E6. Missing reason or invalid period → 422.

steps.text: 6. The system (Auth) checks the target account is not oneself, not an Admin and not already banned; it updates the status with a conditional statement. E3, E4, E5.

exceptions.text: E3. Acting on oneself → 403 "You cannot act on your own account"; the target account is an Admin → 403.
E4. The account is already banned (when banning / suspending) or not restricted (when restoring) → 409.
E5. The status was just changed by another Admin → 409 "The account status has just changed, please reload".

steps.text: 7. For suspension / ban, the system revokes every sign-in session of the account (effective at once, UC#23). E7.

exceptions.text: E7. A failed device sign-out or event publish is only logged.

steps.text: 8. The system publishes account.moderated; Notification creates an in-app notification, then sends an email; Tour writes the action log. E8.

exceptions.text: E8. No email → the email is skipped, the in-app notification is still stored.

steps: A1. Restore: the Admin chooses "Restore" for a suspended or banned account (reason optional); the account returns to Active. E4.
A2. Suspend again (the new period replaces the old one) or ban a suspended account.
A3. The suspension period ends: the account is treated as Active on its own, with no Admin action needed.
